limitations: Only the finite members of the indicated q=3 pencil. Scheme-theoretic discriminant multiplicities, lambda=infinity and q!=3 are not evaluated. Novelty remains subject to unindexed literature.
scientific_integrity: Exact characteristic-three algebraic elimination proves the reduced geometric singular-parameter locus of the finite pencil; all claims have direct proof and executable polynomial tests; no independent external validation is claimed.
title: The 28 geometric singular parameters of a plane-filling sextic pencil in characteristic three
